Johnson, D., Kralovic, P. and Romaniuk, J. (2016). Crude Oil and Natural Gas Supply Costs in Canada, Study No. 159. Canadian Energy Research Institute, Calgary, September 2016. ISBN 1-927037-43-0.

NO TECHNOLOGY PARAMETERS EXTRACTED. A play-level supply cost and production forecast study for Canadian crude oil and natural gas (well-licensing based drilling forecasts). Supply costs by play are shown only in figures; the text prints a few weighted-average supply costs (e.g. 1.83 C$/Mcf for ten Alberta areas) and no capital cost, operating cost or energy use per unit of equipment or process. Methodology assumptions printed: 10% real discount rate, 2015 C$, exchange rate 1 USD = 1.279 CAD. Nothing here describes a heat-supplying or emission-abating technology.
Any use of play supply costs would be chart-derived (_other-values) and is not a technology cost; none extracted.
